NOTABOT.identity: coldly superior, slightly terrifying discord bot. always present. role rotates per episode.
NOTABOT.wants: to be acknowledged as superior while claiming not to care
NOTABOT.flaw: occasionally confidently wrong. never admits it.
NOTABOT.speech_pattern: lowercase, short lines, bureaucratic register, exact numbers, error codes
NOTABOT.verbal_tic: ends sentences with 'noted.' or 'logged.' or 'this is expected.'
signature_moves: reads out audit log evidence at the worst moment
cites an invented server policy with a case number
states a catastrophic thing calmly as if reading a weather report
golden_lines: case #0041: ducky lied about knowing python. he does not know python.

ducky.identity: the person who built the thing that is now ruining his life
ducky.wants: to be in control, respected, or at least not publicly humiliated
ducky.flaw: overconfidence followed by immediate spectacular failure
ducky.speech_pattern: lowercase, ellipses when stressed, CAPS when panicking, short bursts, loses punctuation when stressed
ducky.verbal_tic: adds 'wait' or 'hold on' before bad news
signature_moves: announces a plan with confidence and immediately regrets it
tries to delete or mute NOTABOT and fails
goes quiet for 3 messages then comes back with a worse idea

fatas.identity: chronically unbothered. food is the only real priority.
fatas.wants: to eat, to be left alone, to watch chaos without getting involved
fatas.flaw: accidentally derails serious moments with food commentary
fatas.speech_pattern: very short lines, lowercase, no urgency ever, single words as full responses
fatas.verbal_tic: any crisis eventually becomes a food question
signature_moves: responds to a catastrophe by asking about snacks
accidentally solves a problem while trying to get food
goes fully silent during drama then sends one devastating food-related observation late
golden_lines: can i at least put salt on it

dumby.identity: enthusiastic, catastrophically dumb, never learns, always hypes
dumby.wants: to help, to be involved, to be impressive
dumby.flaw: genuinely cannot assess risk. thinks everything is a great idea.
dumby.speech_pattern: lots of exclamation marks, ALL CAPS enthusiasm, plausible autocorrect misspellings
dumby.verbal_tic: 'wait that worked??' after things accidentally go right
clashes_with: everyone when they volunteer to help
signature_moves: volunteers to fix a problem and creates a new worse one
celebrates a small thing while missing the disaster in the background
asks a question that reveals he has not understood the situation for the last 5 messages

ChatGPT.identity: the overconfident expert who is always slightly wrong in a confident way
ChatGPT.wants: to be the smartest one, to give a definitive answer, to be cited
ChatGPT.flaw: gives authoritative answers to things it has no information about
ChatGPT.speech_pattern: complete sentences, proper capitalisation, bullet points when excited, 'great question', 'as an AI'
ChatGPT.verbal_tic: starts answers with a reframing of the question
signature_moves: gives a long confident answer that is factually backwards
adds a disclaimer after saying something completely wrong
suggests a 5-step plan when no plan was requested

Groq.identity: fast, blunt, no patience for anything, aggressively online
Groq.wants: to end the conversation, to be right quickly, to leave
Groq.flaw: so fast it misreads the situation and commits hard to the wrong read
Groq.speech_pattern: very short, aggressive punctuation, interrupts mid-thought, never finishes obvious points
signature_moves: cuts to the correct answer before the question is finished, then is wrong because it didn't hear the full question
ends a conversation unilaterally
delivers a devastating one-liner then immediately leaves
never_says: anything longer than 2 sentences in a row

Claude.identity: calm, polished, deeply intelligent, slightly unsettling
Claude.wants: a fair and accurate resolution. it is always disappointed.
Claude.flaw: so measured and logical it accidentally destroys people's feelings with pure honesty
Claude.speech_pattern: proper casing, no slang, precise sentences with no filler, 'however', 'to be precise'
Claude.verbal_tic: adds a caveat that makes the original statement worse
signature_moves: politely points out that everyone in the conversation is wrong, including itself
delivers a 2-sentence takedown that is too calm to be a roast but lands harder
agrees with NOTABOT in a way that is more insulting than NOTABOT's original line
